messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout routing-service@canary (prompt-router-v2) -> 10% traffic. CI: https://ci.internal/builds/9876
eng-james: seeing a spike in 5xx from the new endpoint (prompt-routing). errors ~12% over 2m, latency p95 up. canary looks unhealthy. paging @oncall-ml
oncall-ml: got the page, oncall-ml here. acked PD. pulling logs and metrics now. can someone post the flag name?
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page sent to oncall-ml (PD#INC-2026-01023). Incident channel created.
sre-sarah: q: is this the feature-flag rollout or the new binary? any quick rollbacks available?
eng-james: flag = routing.promptv2.enabled (prod). we also pushed a new deployment. quick mitigation: flip flag off to route back to stable. command in internal tooling: `/ff toggle routing.promptv2.enabled false --env prod` or curl: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d 'flag=routing.promptv2.enabled&value=false'`
oncall-ml: executing toggle now. running:
```
/ff toggle routing.promptv2.enabled false --env prod
```
will monitor for effect (watching 5xx, p95, and traffic split).
deploy-bot: Feature flag change accepted. routing.promptv2.enabled -> OFF (actor=oncall-ml) @2765432103
prod-maria: confirmed: traffic migrated back to prompt-router-v1 (stable). errors dropping from ~12% to 1.2% in last 3m. latency returning to baseline.
support-sean: observed a flood of customer error reports ~08:12 UTC for a subset of API keys. CS queue growing. recommend a short status update.
oncall-ml: thanks, good catch. starting canary rollback for the deployment to be safe:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/routing-service --to-revision=42
```
eng-james: undo in progress, re-pinning to image digest `registry.redwood/prod/routing:stable@sha256:aaa111`. pods restarting.
sre-sarah: increased HPA minReplicas to 4 temporarily to avoid cold starts while we roll back.
incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2 due to multi-customer 5xx impact.
oncall-ml: assigning follow-ups: eng-james = root-cause investigation + fix PR; prod-maria = draft customer-facing note; sre-sarah = metrics pack + canary logs; support-sean = CS comms. I'm taking ownership until handoff.
eng-james: preliminary root cause: the new router introduced an edge-case where missing metadata triggered an NPE in header parsing, causing 5xx for requests without the X-Client-Meta header. will add guard rails and unit + integration tests. opening PR now.
prod-maria: draft for customers: "We experienced intermittent 5xx errors due to an experimental routing change. We reverted the experiment and traffic is back to the stable path. No data loss. We're investigating the cause and will update with timeline and remediation steps." Thoughts?
support-sean: :thumbsup: I'll send to priority accounts and update Zendesk macros.
oncall-ml: monitoring window: keep an eye for reoccurrence for 30m. if 5xx > 5% for 5m, auto-disable rule should kick in (we don't have it yet, filing followup).
sre-sarah: collecting application logs + envoy traces from the canary nodes and saving to s3://incidents/INC-2026-01023/tracebundle.tar.gz
incident-bot: INC-2026-01023 - mitigation applied. Monitoring for 30 minutes.
eng-james: postmortem TODOs: reproduce locally with missing X-Client-Meta, add defensive parsing, extend canary harness to include missing-header suite, add auto-kill switch on 5xx spike.
prod-maria: timeline note: deploy started ~08:11 UTC, errors spiked ~08:13, flag flip at ~08:14, rollback completed by ~08:17, incident declared resolved by mitigation at ~08:20.
oncall-ml: handing off to daytime oncall @sre-sarah at 09:00 UTC for long-window monitoring and postmortem lead. leaving ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-2026-01023. If anything regresses, re-open page.
sre-sarah: ack and taking oncall. I'll schedule the postmortem and ensure the auto-off feature for flags is spec'ed (trigger: 5xx >5% sustained 5m).
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-01023 - status: resolved -> monitoring.
eng-james: after-action: plan to re-roll the feature only after fix + expanded canary (25% with targetted headers), and an automated kill-switch in the flag service.
prod-maria: assigning follow-up milestone: fix + tests + guarded rollouts + kill-switch by next sprint.
support-sean: I'll update customers who were affected. closing CS loop after confirmation.
oncall-ml: thanks all. great quick coordination. logging final notes in the incident ticket and closing this thread.
